issue.title: Simplify gallery card metadata and chat composer
issue.description:
Further simplify several Cards gallery compositions by removing secondary labels/metadata, and refine the chat composer so the disabled send action sits inside the field.

Owner direction:

* Remove the highlighted secondary elements from Storage, Quick find, Recent activity, Weekly steps, and Chat.
* Keep each card's primary visual purpose intact.
* Do not redesign unrelated composition structure.

1. Storage simplification

Remove:

* the plan/renewal subtitle, e.g. "Pro plan · renews October 31";
* the numeric values displayed beside the storage categories:
  * Design files value (for example 8.6);
  * Documents value (for example 3.1);
  * Video value (for example 5.2);
  * Other value (for example 1.5).

Keep:

* Storage title;
* primary usage value;
* progress bar;
* category dots;
* category names.

The category breakdown should read as labels/colors only, without per-category numbers.
After removing the subtitle, rebalance spacing so the card does not retain dead space beneath the title.

2. Quick find simplification

Remove:

* "Quick find" title;
* "Jump anywhere without leaving the keyboard." subtitle.

Keep:

* search/command field;
* command rows/actions;
* shortcut keycaps/icons;
* existing lightweight interaction.

The search field should become the first visible content in the card.

3. Recent activity simplification

Remove:

* the subtitle "Small steps, steady progress.";
* the right-aligned timestamps from each activity row, such as:
  * 10:42;
  * 09:15;
  * 16:08;
  * 14:18.

Keep:

* Recent activity title;
* Today / Yesterday grouping;
* activity icons;
* names/actions/content;
* existing semantic styling.

Do not replace the subtitle or timestamps with other metadata.
Rebalance spacing naturally after subtitle removal.

4. Weekly steps simplification

Remove the weekday labels beneath the bar chart:

* M / T / W / T / F / S / S.

Keep:

* primary step value;
* "Average steps this week" copy;
* weekly comparison badge;
* seven-bar visualization.

Do not leave unnecessary reserved space where the weekday labels were removed.

5. Chat composition simplification

Remove the entire contact header area at the top:

* avatar;
* contact name;
* any header container/divider that exists only for that identity row.

Keep:

* incoming/outgoing message bubbles;
* conversation order/alignment;
* bottom composer.

Composer refinement:

* Keep placeholder text: "Type your message..."
* Move the send icon button inside the input/composer field on the far right.
* The send button must be disabled.
* Disabled button should render using the existing muted/disabled visual treatment so it appears gray/inactive.
* No send behavior or message insertion is required.
* Preserve an accessible name for the disabled icon-only send button.

Prefer existing Input/Button composition patterns rather than inventing a new public composer primitive.

Global constraints:

* Preserve Personal UI semantic tokens.
* Preserve light/dark behavior.
* Preserve Heading / Body / Mono roles where still relevant.
* Do not change card ordering/layout in this ticket.
* Do not add new public resources.
* Do not alter Theme v3, history, persistence, Design Command, or mutation behavior.
* Keep responsive containment and stable outer geometry.

Acceptance:

* Storage plan/renewal subtitle is removed.
* Storage category values are removed while category names/dots remain.
* Quick find title/subtitle are removed and the search field is first.
* Recent activity subtitle is removed.
* Recent activity timestamps are removed.
* Weekly steps weekday labels are removed without leaving stale spacing.
* Chat contact header/avatar/name are removed.
* Chat composer keeps "Type your message...".
* Send icon button is inside the composer field on the far right.
* Send button is disabled and visually muted/gray.
* Chat bubbles remain unchanged in order/alignment.
* No overflow, focus-order, keyboard, accessibility, responsive, or theme regression.
